items.title: Add explicit init profile selection and detection
items.context: Support codex, claude, all, and core profiles. Explicit --profile is source of truth. When absent, detect host markers/env only as an initializer hint: Codex markers choose codex, Claude markers choose claude, both markers choose all, and no markers keep all for backwards compatibility with an explicit output note.
items.userSees: Terminal prints `Init profile: codex (explicit --profile)` for explicit codex, `Init profile: claude (detected Claude Code markers)` for Claude-only markers, and `Init profile: all (compatibility fallback: no host markers detected)` for markerless projects.

happy.desc: Running koala init with --profile=codex|claude|all|core uses the explicit profile as source of truth and reports the selected profile without being changed by host markers or env hints.

Running koala init without --profile resolves the detection matrix as codex for Codex-only markers, claude for Claude-only markers, all for both markers, and all with an explicit compatibility note when no markers are present.

edge.desc: If both Codex and Claude markers are present, detection chooses all instead of preferring one host implicitly.
If no host markers are present, init keeps the backward-compatible all profile and prints a note that detection fell back rather than silently pretending a host-specific choice was made.

adversarial.desc: Host marker or env detection must never override an explicit --profile request, even when the requested profile conflicts with detected markers.

items.title: Generate canonical KOALA.md plus profile-specific adapter assets
items.context: Implement a mechanical asset matrix. All profiles create core docs/config dirs, KOALA.md, and bin/koala.js. codex creates AGENTS.md, .Codex/README.md, .Codex/koala.json, .Codex/agents, and bin/koala-codex.js while skipping CLAUDE.md and .claude-only assets. claude creates CLAUDE.md, .claude/agents, .claude/skills/koala, .claude/hooks, .claude/settings.json while skipping .Codex assets and bin/koala-codex.js. all preserves current dual-stack behavior. core creates no host adapter files. Existing AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md/KOALA.md with koala markers sync only the koala section; user-owned files without markers are preserved and skipped.
items.userSees: For `--profile=codex`, `find` shows `KOALA.md`, `AGENTS.md`, `.Codex/README.md`, `.Codex/koala.json`, `.Codex/agents/*`, `bin/koala.js`, `bin/koala-codex.js`, and prints `Skipping Claude Code assets for Codex profile`; `CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/` are absent. Claude/all/core show their corresponding matrix text.

happy.desc: codex profile generates KOALA.md, core docs/config assets, bin/koala.js, AGENTS.md, .Codex/README.md, .Codex/koala.json, .Codex/agents, and bin/koala-codex.js while skipping CLAUDE.md and .claude-only assets.

claude profile generates KOALA.md, core docs/config assets, bin/koala.js, CLAUDE.md, .claude/agents, .claude/skills/koala, .claude/hooks, and .claude/settings.json while skipping .Codex assets and bin/koala-codex.js.
all profile preserves dual-stack generation, and core profile generates only the neutral core assets plus KOALA.md without any host adapter files.

edge.desc: Existing AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or KOALA.md files that contain koala markers sync only the managed koala section and leave user content outside the markers unchanged.
Existing user-owned AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or KOALA.md files without koala markers are preserved and skipped instead of being overwritten.

adversarial.desc: The asset matrix is mechanical: a host-specific profile must not leak the other host adapter files or overwrite unmarked user-owned files in order to make init appear successful.

items.title: Add hard-coded init profile contract coverage
items.context: Add hard-coded contract coverage for the init profile matrix and existing-file preservation. Codex adapter verification remains required only for codex/all profiles that generate .Codex assets; claude/core profiles must not call or require runCodexAdapterChecks unless --verify-codex is explicitly requested, in which case the command should explain that the selected profile has no Codex adapter assets instead of treating missing .Codex as drift.
items.userSees: `npm run test:entrypoints` prints `entrypoints verified`; `koala init --profile=core --verify-codex /tmp/app` prints `Codex verification skipped: init profile core does not generate Codex adapter assets` instead of a missing `.Codex` failure.

happy.desc: Hard-coded contract coverage passes for the init profile matrix and existing-file preservation, and fails if generated assets no longer match the selected profile rules.
codex and all profiles that generate .Codex assets continue to require Codex adapter verification as part of their contract coverage.

edge.desc: claude and core profiles do not call or require runCodexAdapterChecks during normal init validation when they generate no .Codex assets.

adversarial.desc: When --verify-codex is explicitly requested for claude or core, the command explains that the selected profile has no Codex adapter assets instead of reporting missing .Codex files as adapter drift.
Coverage must catch wrong-profile asset generation or unmarked existing-file overwrite regressions rather than passing because the tests only assert successful command exit.
